summary: Georgia Power Company filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a public offering of Series 2026B Senior Notes, with terms (principal amount, interest rate, maturity) left blank. The notes are unsecured unsubordinated obligations ranking equally with existing unsecured debt. The offering is not contingent on concurrent offerings of additional Series 2025B and Series 2026A notes. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation features such as acquisition, restructuring, or tender are present.
